segments.text: The Necromancer responsible for the vice governor's abduction.
Formerly a member of the Cheetah Special Operations group.
Fights using military-style Chinese martial arts, with a high-voltage blade and langxian as his primary weapons.
From the in-game profile
元人民解放軍特殊部隊「猟豹」出身のネクロマンサー。
副都知事誘拐事件の主犯格と目される。
「俺は祖国を捨てた」

副都知事誘拐事件の主犯格と目される。
A member of The Laboratory and Milgram's right-hand man. A formidable Necromancer in his own right.
Despite his bulky frame, he is capable of extremely agile, unpredictable movement via the use of CNT wires.
From the in-game profile
実験室の一員で、ミルグラムの片腕。
手先が器用なネクロマンサーで、特殊な形状のHi-Fi(高機能)リビングデッドの設計なども行う。
「もう、苦痛に苛まれる必要はありませんよ」

手先が器用なネクロマンサーで、特殊な形状のHi-Fi(高機能)リビングデッドの設計なども行う。
A Private Special Living Dead Stalker working for the Karasuzumi Living Dead Stalker Agency. The son of Nagaoka Takeyuki, legendary pioneer of Closed Quarters Armed Martial Arts.
Wields dual pistols equipped with muzzle spikes known as Re-Eliminators and fights using CQAMA, aided by his Ex-Brain.
Calm and collected, but bad at expressing his emotions. His partner Ethica is known to needle him about this.
From the in-game profile
優秀な生死者追跡者の少年。冷静沈着だが感情表現や他人の心を推し量ることが苦手で、事務所の仲間からはボンクラ呼ばわりされている。
2丁のマズルスパイク付き拳銃リ・エリミネーターと、外部電脳エクスブレインを利用し、近接銃術という対リビングデッド戦闘に特化した格闘技で戦う。
「ぼくの仕事は、死体を殺すこと」
優秀な生死者追跡者リビングデッド・ストーカーの少年。冷静沈着だが感情表現や他人の心を推し量ることが苦手で、事務所の仲間からはボンクラ呼ばわりされている。

A Private Special Living Dead Stalker working for the Karasuzumi Living Dead Stalker Agency.
Birthed from Aso Yukari's womb using a fertilized egg created with induced pluripotent stem cells from Kibanohara Hokoyasu and Nagaoka Takeyuki.
Raised together with Aso Kiriri like sisters.
Acts based on her gut instinct; the type to shoot first, ask questions later. A lesbian who just can't get enough of pretty girls.
Capable of wielding a wide variety of weapons like the AK-50 Kalashnikov and the AA-24 Custom, based on what a given combat situation demands. Her go-to is a portable chainsaw called Rabbit Punch.
Edited from the in-game profile
早雲の相棒、凶暴で美しい少女。同じく生死者追跡者で、様々な武器を使いこなす。感情的で直感を元に行動するなど、早雲とは対照的。レズビアンで可愛い女の子に目がない。
ラビットパンチと呼ぶ携帯チェーンソーを多用するが、他にもフルオートショットガンやWASPナイフつきアサルトライフルなど、状況によって様々な武器を使い分けるのが強み。
An amnesiac girl who claims to have the same name as a famous virtual environment designer.
Extremely familiar with otaku culture from the late 20th and early 21st centuries, occasionally using slang that no one around her understands.

Was held in the Ikebukuro CPC as a child, used in human experiments. These experiments granted her enhanced empathy. While at the Ikebukuro CPC, she was close friends with Con Su (known as Risa at the time).
After escaping from the Ikebukuro CPC, she lived with Sori Ayuka in The Fortress.
She is the sole human able to make contact with Substance-Concept, due to her enhanced empathy.
From the in-game profile
会話しているだけで人の心を開かせる不思議な魅力をもつ少女。一部記憶を失っており、ネクロマンサーに身柄を狙われている。
20世紀のオタクカルチャーに造詣が深く、流行遅れの言葉を口にすることもしばしば。
「君は……だれ？」

A Living Dead Stalker belonging to the Gijo Living Dead Stalker Agency. Can be considered a rival of So'un and his comrades. Prideful to a fault, with a somewhat abrasive demeanor.
Practitioner of the Advanced Taisha School. Her ultrasonic vibro-katana, Shoushimaru, sunders all in its path.
Lives with her undead brother Sumihiko, having sworn herself to revenge against Milgram.
Based on the in-game profile

Taken in by Kibanohara Hokoyasu at a young age. A dependable sister figure for Ethica.

Owner of the Frozen Nirvana, a junk shop located in the Hyper Ghetto.
A highly-skilled hacker, her true face is that of an information broker.
Frequently does business with the Karasuzumi Living Dead Stalker Agency.
A complete shut-in who never leaves her store.
Was formerly held in captivity at the Ikebukuro CPC, where she was close friends with Hogyo Iria.
Went to great lengths to search out Iria's whereabouts after the Ikebukuro CPC was dissolved; Iria's escape from The Fortress was facilitated by none other than Con Su.
From the in-game profile

Originally the leader of the Close Quarters Armed Martial Arts Training Unit, where he contributed greatly to both the development of the Ex-Brain and the refinement of CQAMA as a fighting style.

Fell deeply in love with Nagaoka Takeyuki. After Takeyuki's death, he extracted genetic information from his corpse and combined it with his own, creating a fertilized egg which Aso Yukari raised in her womb. Thus Kibanohara Ethica was born.
Said to wear an iron mask, as his face never betrays even the slightest hint of emotion.
